title.en: Explicit sieve and prime-counting analytic inputs
title.zh: 显式筛法与素数分布解析输入

description.en: Complete explicit analytic & sieve prerequisite suite (21 tasks): Schoenfeld RH prime-counting (L-A1..L-A6), Grenié–Molteni / Johnston–Starichkova GRH primes in arithmetic progressions (L-B1..L-B6), unconditional explicit Mertens reciprocal prime sums (L-C1..L-C5), Montgomery–Vaughan multiplicative large sieve (πN + Q² and sharp N + Q²), and unconditional Pan–Ding / Chen switched semiprime upper bounds.
description.zh: 面向显式哥德巴赫与陈氏筛的完整解析与筛法前置题组（共 21 题）：Schoenfeld RH 素数计数链（L-A1..L-A6）、Grenié–Molteni / Johnston–Starichkova GRH 算术级数素数链（L-B1..L-B6）、无条件显式 Mertens 素数倒数和链（L-C1..L-C5）、Montgomery–Vaughan 乘性大筛不等式（πN + Q² 与锐利 N + Q²），以及潘承洞–丁夏畦/陈景润无条件切换半素数经典上界。
